description:
*Manjulaben Dolatrai Desai Rotary Borivli Eye bank* were once again invited by *Terapanthi Jain Samaj* in one of their events, which was held on 5/9/2026 to give talk on the *Eye donation awareness*, as they also are celebrating eye donation awareness pakhwada. Once every year we have been so invited . *PP Ashish Tapiawala* gave quite a broader idea covering all the important aspects of the eye donation in his address to the Gan of Acharya Sadhvijis on the dias and around 400 people who listened to the details of eye donation in a rapt silence. Later on a few inquiries were also answered.
We both *PP Ashish Tapiawala* and myself *Rtn. Ketan Shah* were blessed by Sadhviji and by group of working committee by honouring us with stole with Jain mantra written on it.
It is for the information of those who may not know that the Jain community, infect very small in its population out of 650 crore Indians, has been foremost in the numbers for donating eyes. We all need to take up this cause very seriously and extend our hands in bringing awareness for eye donation. So that cornially blind persons can get back their vision and lead a normal independent life.
